name: CI-CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

env:
  REGISTRY: marwaahmed11
  TAG: latest

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build Docker Images
        run: |
          docker build -t $REGISTRY/frontend:$TAG ./client
          docker build -t $REGISTRY/backend:$TAG ./server
          docker build -t $REGISTRY/db:$TAG ./database
          docker ps

      - name: Run Containers (CD)
        run: |
          docker network create app-net || true

          docker rm -f mongodb backend frontend || true

          docker run -d --name mongodb -p 27017:27017 --net app-net $REGISTRY/db:$TAG
          docker run -d --name backend -p 8088:8080 -e PORT=8080 --net app-net $REGISTRY/backend:$TAG
          docker run -d --name frontend -p 8090:3000 --net app-net $REGISTRY/frontend:$TAG

          docker ps -a
          docker ps
